legend.title: What the badges mean
legend.mandatory: Required every time; missing it raises the risk level to at least “medium”.
legend.recommended: Good practice that counts toward the score but does not raise the risk level on its own.
legend.critical: A violation is an automatic “high” risk, whatever the rest of the result.
legend.visual: A still photo can show it, so the smart scan checks it.
legend.weight: From 1 to 3; the higher the weight, the more the step counts toward the score.

fields.descriptionHint: When and where the protocol applies, and who it is for.
fields.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, digits and hyphens. It is filled in from the English title and cannot be changed after the protocol is created.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Put the steps in the order staff carry them out. Give each one a short reason, and cite the WHO or CDC guidance it is based on.

steps.locked: It cannot be removed, and whether it is mandatory or critical, its weight and its photo check stay as they are, so past results keep their meaning. You can still fix its wording, which past reports then show too; to change what it asks for, create a new version of the protocol.
steps.lastStep: A protocol needs at least one step.

fields.textHint: One clear action, e.g. “Drop the used needle straight into the sharps container.”
fields.rationaleHint: The reason in a sentence or two; trainees read it when they get the step wrong.
fields.mandatoryHint: Required every time. Missing it raises the risk to at least “medium”.
fields.criticalHint: A violation means “high” risk automatically, e.g. recapping a used needle.
fields.weightHint: How much the step counts toward the score.
fields.visual: Can be checked in a photo
fields.visualHint: The smart scan checks it from the examiner's photos. Only for things a still photo can show.
fields.criteriaAr: What the photo must show, in Arabic
fields.criteriaEn: What the photo must show, in English
fields.criteriaHint: What a compliant photo looks like, e.g. “The sharps container is closed and filled below the line.”
fields.referenceLabelHint: The guideline the step is based on, e.g. <en>WHO Guidelines on Hand Hygiene in Health Care (2009)</en>.
fields.referenceUrlHint: A secure address that starts with <en>https://</en>

steps.linkedTitle: A training scenario uses this step
steps.linkedNote: It cannot be removed while a scenario answer is linked to it. You can still change it; to remove it, create a new version of the protocol.

saveBar.newDraft: The protocol is saved as a draft; you can publish it afterwards.
saveBar.live: Published: saved changes appear right away.

publish.title: Publish this protocol?
publish.global: Every user of the platform will see it in the library, every institution's examiners can scan with it, and scenarios linked to it can be played.
publish.institution: Your institution's members will see it in the library, and your examiners can scan with it.

unpublish.title: Unpublish this protocol?
unpublish.global: It leaves the library for everyone and can no longer be chosen for new scans. Past results are kept, and you can publish it again at any time.
unpublish.institution: It leaves your institution's library and can no longer be chosen for new scans. Past results are kept, and you can publish it again at any time.

version.title: Create a new version?
version.description: An unpublished copy with all the steps is created. Edit it, publish it, then unpublish this version. Past results stay with this version.
version.copies: {count, plural, one {One institution copy was} other {# institution copies were}} made from this version. Copies never change by themselves, but the owners and admins of those institutions see a note about the new version once it is published. The copies show this version's training scenarios while it has published ones, otherwise the new version's.

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.description: The protocol and its steps are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

history.title: How changes work
history.live: A published protocol is live: saved changes show up right away in the library, in new scans and in new simulation attempts.
history.pastResults: Past scans and simulation results keep the scores they already have. Their reports show each step's current wording, so a wording fix shows there too; the editor asks before it rewords a step that has results.
history.locked: Steps that already have results cannot be removed, and what they ask for (mandatory, critical, weight, photo check) stays as it is. A protocol with results cannot be deleted.
history.version: To remove such a step or change what it asks for, create a new version: edit it, publish it, then unpublish the old one.
history.versionHint: This protocol already has results. For bigger changes, work on a new version.
